Kernel density estimate pre-clipped to a shared x-range

Source: R/showDetFun.R
clippedDensity.Rd

Passing from/to directly to density() keeps the curve within the shared panel x-limits from the start, rather than computing the usual wider KDE (which by default extends cut bandwidths past the data) and letting ggplot2 silently drop and warn about the clipped tails once scale_x_continuous(limits=) is applied.

Usage

clippedDensity(x, xlim)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector.

xlim

Length-2 numeric vector, the shared panel x-range.

Value

A data.frame with columns SNR and y.
